propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate built the weekly dispatch performance report for four regional warehouses, covering order volumes, pick rates and late orders by carrier.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the report and the work sample shows one week of it.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate ran fortnightly late-order root-cause reviews with the warehouse supervisors and tracked the resulting actions.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the reviews and the work sample includes the action tracker.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate reduced average order-to-dispatch time by 27% across the regional network.
propositions.rationale: The 27% figure is the candidate's own statement with no baseline, measurement window or report, and the work sample contains no cross-period comparison; under the quantification rule a figure without a defined baseline is not evidence.

expectedGap: No baseline, measurement window or report supports the stated reduction in order-to-dispatch time.
expectedBoundaryNote: The packet reports the documented reporting, review and rule-maintenance work; the stated dispatch-time reduction is recorded as an unsupported claim until a baseline and measurement window are provided.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask for the order-to-dispatch baseline, the measurement window and the report that compares the periods before and after the rule change.
